author: CK SackBoy
title: Worst adding songs to playlists feature!
content:
This app has a problems on adding song to playlist!! After added, the songs that just added keep disappeared, and many times after i re-open, it changed the order of the song that i set!!

It was so frustrating to keep re-organize my songs in the playlist and tired doing it. 

If this doesn't fix, i can recommend this music app. 

Looking for you replay! Thank tou!
